access_type.description: How renters connect to a remote-access listing; matches remote-access listings only.

category.description: Exact category value, e.g. AI_COMPUTE or EXCAVATORS; rigshare_list_categories returns the values that currently have listings. Overrides division. An unknown value is an error.

city.description: Exact city name, case-insensitive. There is no radius search.

compute_architecture.description: Accelerator family of an AI compute listing.

division.description: Division to search (default all). Ignored when category is set.

max_price_daily_usd.description: Upper bound on the listing's daily rate, in USD.

min_price_daily_usd.description: Lower bound on the listing's daily rate, in USD.

remote_only.description: true = only listings rented over the network (AI compute, AI infrastructure and IoT sensor listings).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the listing title only (not the description, make/model or location).

sort.description: Default newest. price_asc / price_desc sort by daily rate; rating = highest average rating first.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX (exact match).

id.description: Listing UUID (the id field from rigshare_search_equipment).

division_hint.description: Set when the division is known; otherwise it is inferred from equipment_type.

equipment_type.description: Free-text description of the owner's equipment, e.g. "H100 server" or "mini excavator"; used to pick the division-specific section.

budget_usd.description: METERED listings only, and required for them: the maximum session spend to authorize, in USD, fees included. Only the minutes actually used are charged. rigshare_quote_booking returns the minimum budget and presets.

coverage_path.description: Required for physical (non-remote) equipment. WAIVER = the renter accepts RIGShare's Liability Acknowledgment Waiver (only with the renter's explicit, informed consent); BYOCOI = the renter will provide their own certificate of insurance.

duration_type.description: Pricing unit. HOURLY bills every started hour between start and end; FOUR_HOURS bills 4-hour blocks and must start by 4:00 PM equipment-local time; DAILY bills per day; WEEKLY per started 7 days; MONTHLY per started 30 days.

end_date.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, after start_date. Same format rules as start_date.

pickup_type.description: SELF_PICKUP, or OWNER_DELIVERY (adds the owner's delivery fee). rigshare_create_booking refuses OWNER_DELIVERY on a listing that does not offer delivery and on any remote-access listing; rigshare_quote_booking does not check this, so a quote can succeed for a booking that will be refused. Omitted = REMOTE_ACCESS, which is treated as self pickup; whether a booking is remote comes from the listing itself.

qualification_answers.description: Answers to the renter-qualification questionnaire, required only when the listing requires renter qualification. The questionnaire is not available through this API, so if a booking is refused for qualification the renter must book that listing on the web; retrying here will not get past it.

qualification_version.description: Version of the questionnaire the answers were given against; must match the current version.

start_date.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time. A date alone is read as UTC midnight (the previous afternoon or evening in US time zones), so for HOURLY and FOUR_HOURS send a date-time with a UTC offset in the equipment's local time, e.g. 2026-09-15T08:00:00-05:00.

waiver_version.description: Version of the waiver the renter accepted. Omit to use the current version.

budget_usd.description: METERED listings only, and required for them: the maximum session spend to authorize, in USD, fees included. Only the minutes actually used are charged. rigshare_quote_booking returns the minimum budget and presets.

coverage_path.description: Required for physical (non-remote) equipment. WAIVER = the renter accepts RIGShare's Liability Acknowledgment Waiver (only with the renter's explicit, informed consent); BYOCOI = the renter will provide their own certificate of insurance.

duration_type.description: Pricing unit. HOURLY bills every started hour between start and end; FOUR_HOURS bills 4-hour blocks and must start by 4:00 PM equipment-local time; DAILY bills per day; WEEKLY per started 7 days; MONTHLY per started 30 days.

end_date.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, after start_date. Same format rules as start_date.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, recommended: a new value for each booking you intend, the same value when retrying it (printable ASCII, up to 100 characters — a UUID works). A request that matches a pending, approved or confirmed booking you created in the last 5 minutes (same equipment, same dates — for a same-day remote session, the same UTC day — same duration type, and the same price, usage budget, compute environment, pickup/delivery choice and coverage choice) is never booked or charged a second time: with the same key, or with no key, you get that booking back, marked idempotent, with its payment state and next action; with a different key it is normally refused with HTTP 409 IDENTICAL_BOOKING_RECENT, which names the existing booking — confirm with the user before booking the same thing again (if the original request's key isn't on record, you get the booking back instead). Reusing a key for a request that doesn't match its booking is refused with HTTP 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: check that booking before booking again. For a per-minute (metered) listing, two requests with the same usage budget match whatever their length; a listing that serves one renter at a time has no room for a second same-day session anyway.

pickup_type.description: SELF_PICKUP, or OWNER_DELIVERY (adds the owner's delivery fee). rigshare_create_booking refuses OWNER_DELIVERY on a listing that does not offer delivery and on any remote-access listing; rigshare_quote_booking does not check this, so a quote can succeed for a booking that will be refused. Omitted = REMOTE_ACCESS, which is treated as self pickup; whether a booking is remote comes from the listing itself.

qualification_answers.description: Answers to the renter-qualification questionnaire, required only when the listing requires renter qualification. The questionnaire is not available through this API, so if a booking is refused for qualification the renter must book that listing on the web; retrying here will not get past it.

qualification_version.description: Version of the questionnaire the answers were given against; must match the current version.

start_date.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time. A date alone is read as UTC midnight (the previous afternoon or evening in US time zones), so for HOURLY and FOUR_HOURS send a date-time with a UTC offset in the equipment's local time, e.g. 2026-09-15T08:00:00-05:00.

waiver_version.description: Version of the waiver the renter accepted. Omit to use the current version.

billing_mode.description: FIXED (default): upfront pricing. METERED: per-minute session billing, for remote-access listings only; requires hourly_rate_usd.

booking_type.description: REQUEST: the owner approves each booking. INSTANT: renters are confirmed without approval; a physical INSTANT listing needs a street address, which the agent API cannot set. Default REQUEST.

category.description: Listing category. Remote access is available only for AI_COMPUTE, AI_INFRASTRUCTURE and IOT_SENSORS; robots, drones and 3D printers are physical rentals.

deposit_display_usd.description: Deposit figure displayed on the listing, in USD. RIGShare never holds or charges it on its own; it is the most RIGShare will collect if a renter expressly accepts a damage claim. 0 = the owner requires no deposit; omit to state no figure. Must be within the bound set by replacement_value_usd. Not used on remote-access listings.

external_id.description: Your own inventory/SKU id; rigshare_check_availability and rigshare_sync_availability find the listing by it. If you already own a listing with this external_id, this call updates that listing instead of creating a new one.

hourly_rate_usd.description: Hourly rate in USD. Required for billing_mode METERED, where it is the rate the per-minute meter bills at.

photos.description: 1-8 photos as https URLs, or {url, angle} objects where angle labels the shot (e.g. front, side, back). At least one is required.

remote_access.description: Network access for AI compute, AI infrastructure or IoT sensor listings. Omit for physical equipment.

endpoint.description: https URL of the owner's service that renter sessions connect to.

require_mfa.description: Require renters to pass TOTP multi-factor authentication to start a session (default true). Agents cannot start sessions on such listings.

security_ack.description: The owner's attestation that the endpoint is secured and that they accept the Terms and Liability Waiver. Must be true to publish; send it only when the owner has actually given it.

replacement_value_usd.description: What the item costs to replace, in USD. Required to publish a physical (non-remote) listing. It bounds the deposit figure the listing may display: 10% of this value, at least $25 and at most $1,000.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX.

ends_at.description: End of the range to test (ISO 8601). Needs starts_at.

external_id.description: The inventory/SKU id the listing was created with (rigshare_create_listing's external_id).

starts_at.description: Start of a range to test against the blocked windows (ISO 8601). Needs ends_at.

blocks.description: The complete set of unavailable windows for this listing; replaces the previously synced set.

ends_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time the window ends, after starts_at. Same format as starts_at.

reason.description: Note stored on the block, prefixed "External sync:" unless it already starts with "ERP:".

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time the window starts, with Z or a UTC offset (e.g. 2026-09-15T08:00:00-05:00); sent to RIGShare as UTC. A time with neither is refused.

external_id.description: The inventory/SKU id the listing was created with (rigshare_create_listing's external_id).

booking_id.description: The booking to start a session on.
The METERED booking to end and settle.

reason.description: Free-text note recorded in the audit log. It does not affect the refund.

additional_minutes.description: Minutes of extra budget to authorize at the listing's per-minute rate: 15, 30 or 60.

booking_id.description: The METERED booking whose running session to extend.
The METERED booking to report on.

booking_id.description: Booking UUID (the booking_id returned by rigshare_create_booking).

session_id.description: Session UUID, from rigshare_start_session, rigshare_list_my_sessions or rigshare_get_booking.

ownership_ack.description: The owner's attestation that they own or are authorized to rent the equipment and that it is in safe working condition.
